identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed backlog remains identifiable across membership changes, reprioritization, container migration and planning cycles.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Each ordered membership or ranking-policy change creates an immutable backlog revision while preserving prior order, rationale and source correlations.

owns: rank and ranking rationale within each revision

invariants: Backlog identity is independent of tracker board, project, iteration and any member WorkItem.
Rank belongs to one immutable backlog revision and never to WorkItem identity.
Every membership references an externally mastered WorkItem and never copies its workflow state.
Reordering creates a successor revision and preserves the predecessor order and rationale.
Membership removal never deletes the WorkItem or prior membership evidence.
A tracker board becomes a backlog only through an explicit governed mapping and owner.
Backlog scope states the planning authority and does not imply Project, Program or Portfolio identity.
Requirement intent and acceptance criteria remain externally mastered.
Estimate and priority scales are referenced explicitly and never inferred from rank alone.
Concurrent revisions require explicit branch or reconciliation state and never silently overwrite.
Frozen revisions cannot change in place.
Retired backlog identifiers and all revisions remain resolvable and are never recycled.
holds: Registry namespace and identifier allocation are pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Tracker adapter and rank-scale crosswalks require frozen audit.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
